heading: Wednesday, January 15, 2025
topLine: De novo designed proteins neutralise lethal snake three-finger toxins in mice. Also: MiniMax open-sources MiniMax-01 models.

items.headline: De novo designed proteins neutralise lethal snake three-finger toxins in mice
items.summary: David Baker's Institute for Protein Design at UW Medicine, with DTU, used RFdiffusion and ProteinMPNN to design small proteins that bind elapid three-finger toxins, which plasma-derived antivenoms address poorly. Published in Nature: the designs neutralised all three toxin subfamilies in vitro and gave 80-100% survival in mice challenged with lethal neurotoxin doses; they do not yet neutralise whole venoms.

items.headline: MiniMax open-sources MiniMax-01 models
items.summary: MiniMax-Text-01 and MiniMax-VL-01 are open-weight models with 456B total and 45.9B active parameters that pair Lightning Attention, a linear-attention mechanism, with mixture-of-experts. MiniMax claims a context length of up to 4 million tokens.
